tokens.name: bg
tokens.usage: Page background in all apps: white. Light colour comes from `wash` bands and `tint-*` pastels placed on top, never from tinting the whole page.

tokens.name: page
tokens.usage: Customer app page behind its cards (bright skin, D-249): a light grey, so white cards lift off it. Only `ink` and `ink-2` text sits directly on it; `ink-3` does not (4.3:1).

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Cards, sheets, list rows, table body, the sidebar, the POS cart. Most of every screen is this white.

tokens.name: surface-subtle
tokens.usage: The faintest grey: table header row, KPI footer band, row hover, the help card at the foot of the sidebar.

tokens.name: surface-sunken
tokens.usage: Segmented-control track, the active sidebar item, soft buttons ("Change"), letter avatars, product image wells.

tokens.name: surface-raised
tokens.usage: Popovers, menus, dialogs; pair with shadow-pop.

tokens.name: media
tokens.usage: Neutral tile behind product photos and initials.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Hairline border on every card, table, panel and the sidebar edge. This border, not a shadow, is what separates white from white.

tokens.name: line-control
tokens.usage: Border of inputs, secondary buttons, icon buttons, checkboxes and count badges.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text and icons. Near-black, never pure #000.

tokens.name: ink-2
tokens.usage: Secondary text: units, store addresses, timestamps, table metadata. 4.5:1+ on every surface.

tokens.name: ink-3
tokens.usage: Placeholder text, disabled labels, group labels. Never for prices or stock.

tokens.name: brand
tokens.usage: The green accent, spent in a few places only: success and freshness signals (in stock, ready, completed, synced, a rise), the chart line and highlighted bar, progress fills, the active sidebar icon, and the customer cart bar and checkout button (`tz-btn-brand`). Never a page, card or sidebar fill (the pale `wash` mint is the light colour for bands, not brand).

tokens.name: brand-strong
tokens.usage: Hover and pressed state of brand fills.

tokens.name: brand-mark
tokens.usage: The exact logo green. Illustrations, map pins, non-text marks only: white text on it is 4.4:1 and fails.

tokens.name: brand-soft
tokens.usage: Small tinted backgrounds only: the Ready pill, the rise chip, the "stock updated" tag. Never a card or panel fill.

tokens.name: on-brand
tokens.usage: Label and icon colour on a brand or brand-strong fill.

tokens.name: inverse
tokens.usage: The solid fill: primary buttons, selected chips, the quantity stepper, toasts, tooltips, the POS total bar, the pickup code and the wallet card. Near-black in light theme, near-white in dark.

tokens.name: on-inverse
tokens.usage: Text and icons on inverse.

tokens.name: on-inverse-2
tokens.usage: Secondary text on inverse.

tokens.name: warning
tokens.usage: Pending status, low stock, integration-off notices. Text on surface and warning-soft.

tokens.name: warning-soft
tokens.usage: Background for pending and low-stock pills.

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Rejected, cancelled, out-of-stock-after-order, destructive buttons. A vermilion that sits apart from brand green in lightness too; always paired with a word or icon.

tokens.name: danger-soft
tokens.usage: Background for danger pills and inline errors.

tokens.name: on-danger
tokens.usage: Label on a danger fill.

tokens.name: info
tokens.usage: Accepted and out-for-delivery statuses, informational banners, the focus ring's hue family.

tokens.name: info-soft
tokens.usage: Background for info pills and banners.

tokens.name: teal
tokens.usage: Preparing status only, so it can sit next to Accepted without a second blue.

tokens.name: teal-soft
tokens.usage: Background for the preparing pill.

tokens.name: promo-plum
tokens.usage: Promo banner fill on the customer Home carousel (bright skin, D-249), with white text (9:1). Banners only, never a card or page.

tokens.name: promo-blue
tokens.usage: Promo banner fill on the customer Home carousel (D-249), with white text (6.7:1). Banners only.

tokens.name: promo-rose
tokens.usage: Promo banner fill on the customer Home carousel (D-249), with white text (6.1:1). Banners only. The green banner uses `brand`.

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: Keyboard focus ring: 2px solid, offset 2px over the page colour. 3:1+ on bg and surface in both themes.

tokens.name: scrim
tokens.usage: Behind bottom sheets and dialogs.

tokens.name: scrim-photo
tokens.usage: The dark end of the gradient under white text on a photo (shop card cashback, promo banners; bright skin, D-249). White text sits only on the darkest part.

tokens.name: wash
tokens.usage: The light colour of TodayZ: a pale mint for hero bands (top of the customer home, the greeting band on the business overview, marketing sections), the active sidebar item, the KPI lead cell and the setup card. Pale enough that white cards on it still read as white.

tokens.name: wash-strong
tokens.usage: Top stop of the hero-band gradient and the active sidebar item. Never behind body text smaller than 13px.

tokens.name: wash-line
tokens.usage: Border of a washed band or washed card, in place of `line`.

tokens.name: tint-green
tokens.usage: Pastel fill, paired with tint-green-ink: Grocery category, "Selling fast" insight.

tokens.name: tint-green-ink
tokens.usage: Icon and text on tint-green.

tokens.name: tint-amber
tokens.usage: Pastel fill: Stationery category, "Sitting on the shelf" insight.

tokens.name: tint-amber-ink
tokens.usage: Icon and text on tint-amber.

tokens.name: tint-rose
tokens.usage: Pastel fill: Pharmacy category, "Going to waste" insight.

tokens.name: tint-rose-ink
tokens.usage: Icon and text on tint-rose.

tokens.name: tint-sky
tokens.usage: Pastel fill: Electronics category, "Wanted nearby" insight.

tokens.name: tint-sky-ink
tokens.usage: Icon and text on tint-sky.

tokens.name: tint-lilac
tokens.usage: Pastel fill: Beauty category.

tokens.name: tint-lilac-ink
tokens.usage: Icon and text on tint-lilac.

tokens.name: tint-peach
tokens.usage: Pastel fill: Hardware category.

tokens.name: tint-peach-ink
tokens.usage: Icon and text on tint-peach.

tokens.name: map-land
tokens.usage: Map base: land.

tokens.name: map-park
tokens.usage: Map: parks and open ground.

tokens.name: map-water
tokens.usage: Map: lakes and rivers.

tokens.name: map-road
tokens.usage: Map: road fill.

tokens.name: map-road-edge
tokens.usage: Map: road casing.

families.display: "Anek Latin", "Anek Devanagari", "Anek Kannada", "Anek Telugu", "Anek Tamil", system-ui, sans-serif
families.sans: Figtree, "Noto Sans Devanagari", "Noto Sans Kannada", "Noto Sans Telugu", "Noto Sans Tamil", system-ui, sans-serif

groups.name: Display
groups.note: Anek, from Ek Type in India, has Latin, Devanagari, Kannada, Telugu and Tamil cuts drawn as one family, so headings look the same in every language we ship. Use for headings, big numbers and codes only.

styles.name: display-xl
styles.usage: Onboarding and empty-state headlines; storefront hero.

styles.name: display
styles.usage: Page titles on desktop dashboards; consumer section heroes.

styles.name: headline
styles.usage: Screen titles on phone, card group titles on desktop.

styles.name: otp
styles.usage: Pickup code shown to the customer and typed by the retailer.

groups.name: Text
groups.note: Figtree for Latin text with Noto Sans Devanagari, Kannada, Telugu and Tamil as per-script fallbacks. Turn on tabular numbers (font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums) wherever prices or quantities line up.

styles.name: kpi
styles.usage: Dashboard numbers: medium weight, not bold, as in the Kargul dashboards. Figtree with tabular figures.

styles.name: title
styles.usage: Desktop page title, with a 14px ink-2 subline under it.

styles.name: heading
styles.usage: Card titles and section titles; a 13px ink-2 description may follow.

styles.name: body-lg
styles.usage: Default text in the customer app, and inputs on phone so iOS never zooms.
styles.sample: Pick up from the counter and show this code.

styles.name: body
styles.usage: Default text in the business and admin apps, table cells, nav items.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Form labels, button text in small buttons, filter buttons.

styles.name: overline
styles.usage: Sidebar group labels only. Table headers are sentence case.

styles.name: price
styles.usage: Price in product cards and cart lines; tabular numbers on.

styles.name: price-lg
styles.usage: Totals in cart, checkout and the POS charge button.

spacing.note: 4px base. Phone screens use a 16px gutter; desktop dashboards 24–32px.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon-to-label gap, pill padding-y.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gap inside a row of chips; stepper internals.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Card inner gap; list row padding-y.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Phone side gutter; card padding; default stack gap.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Gap between product cards on desktop grids.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Section gap on phone; desktop card padding.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Section gap on desktop; page padding-top.

tokens.name: space-10
tokens.usage: Large separations on desktop dashboards.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Empty-state padding; hero breathing room.

radius.note: Tight, even corners in the Kargul style: 8px on controls, 10px on buttons, 12px on cards. Nested corners stay concentric.

tokens.name: radius-xs
tokens.usage: Status pills, tags, count badges, checkbox, keyboard hints.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Inputs, small buttons, icon buttons, sidebar items, filter buttons, segmented track.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Default buttons, search field, toasts, banners on phone, product images.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Cards, tables, KPI strip, store and product cards, POS cart panel.

tokens.name: radius-xl
tokens.usage: Top corners of bottom sheets; the cart bar.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Category chips, quantity stepper, round avatars, progress bars.

shadow.note: Cards have no shadow; they use a line border. Shadows are for controls (xs, btn) and for things that float (pop, sheet).

tokens.name: shadow-xs
tokens.usage: Secondary buttons, inputs, the selected segment. Barely there; it lifts a control off white.

tokens.name: shadow-card
tokens.usage: Cards on the grey `page` (bright skin, D-249): replaces the hairline border, so a white card lifts off grey.

tokens.name: shadow-btn
tokens.usage: Filled buttons (primary and brand): a soft drop plus an inner top highlight, as on Kargul Studio buttons.

tokens.name: shadow-pop
tokens.usage: Menus, popovers, the floating cart bar, toasts.

tokens.name: shadow-sheet
tokens.usage: Bottom sheets rising from the bottom edge.

tokens.name: tap-min
tokens.usage: Smallest touch target anywhere in the consumer app.

tokens.name: control-sm
tokens.usage: Small buttons, icon buttons, filter buttons, segmented control and table actions on desktop.

tokens.name: control-md
tokens.usage: Default height for inputs and buttons in the business and admin apps.

tokens.name: control-lg
tokens.usage: Default height for inputs and buttons in the customer app and on any touch screen (density "touch").

tokens.name: control-xl
tokens.usage: Checkout, Place order and onboarding buttons on phone.

tokens.name: pos-key
tokens.usage: POS keypad keys and product tiles' add hit area, for fast counter use.

tokens.name: bottom-nav
tokens.usage: Consumer and retailer phone tab bar height (plus safe-area).

tokens.name: sidebar
tokens.usage: Retailer and admin desktop sidebar width.

tokens.name: content-max
tokens.usage: Max width of desktop dashboards.

tokens.name: phone-max
tokens.usage: Max width of the consumer app column on wide screens.

tokens.name: z-sticky
tokens.usage: Sticky headers and the cart bar.

tokens.name: z-nav
tokens.usage: Bottom nav and sidebar.

tokens.name: z-sheet
tokens.usage: Bottom sheets, dialogs.

tokens.name: z-toast
tokens.usage: Toasts above everything.
